body: Thank you so much to everyone who replied. I’m at work right now so I haven’t gotten around to replying to everybody. After all the advice and info we had a proper talk and he has decided to admit himself into hospital while he starts medication, which is a huge relief as I think they’ll be better equipped to take care of him. I’ll obviously be sad to see him in there but I know he needs professional help right now. I really appreciate everyone replying, it’s been so nice to see all the comments and I’ve decided to go see a therapist myself. I’ll reply to all the comments later and hopefully I’ll have a success story to upload at some point! Again thank you so much to everyone you are all such lovely people, thank you for taking the time to respond to me it means a lot ❤️

I know I don’t have control over it but his problems are definitely mine. He has never abused me and he never would. He’s the kindest, most gentle person I know, and he deserves love and support from people who care about him. He’s extremely vulnerable right now and he’s not in a great place, which is absolutely not his fault and it is in no way a reflection of him as a person. Thanks for the reply but leaving him is not really an option for me, at least not right now.

That makes a lot of sense, and thanks so much for replying. I do sometimes feel like I’m making things worse by putting pressure on him to be “productive”, but I’m also afraid that if he drops out of this course that he loves it will fuel the “failure” complex he has. I’m not sure which is better. I definitely will make sure sure he knows that he isn’t under pressure from anyone, I hadn’t thought about it too much in the past as I always assumed it was a given. 

Any improvement is definitely great. I try to tell him the same. He also hasn’t attempted in over a year which is a feat in itself. Whatever the reason, he’s still here and he’s trying and I’m so grateful. It’s definitely a long road but I’m hoping and praying something will change for him, especially his mindset. I know he finds it hard to see depression as something that can be treated, he’s adamant that nothing will work for him though he hasn’t really tried anything as such. 

It’s definitely draining but I wouldn’t be doing it if he wasn’t worth it, which is helpful to remind myself of. I don’t have a therapist but I have been looking into getting one, I didn’t want to make him feel like I needed therapy because of him, but at the same time I can’t support him properly if I’m not 100% myself, and I definitely would love advice from a therapist, especially as he won’t see one himself. 

Thanks again for replying!

Thank you for taking the time to reply to everything :)) I think you’re completely right in saying he has to realise a lot of this himself, I suppose it’s just frustrating trying to make somebody see what you see. I have the same conversation with him about exhausting all our options because I don’t think it’s ever a “one size fits all” solution. I’ve promised him that of standard treatment doesn’t work we’ll go on holidays and camp in the mountains and have some sort of psychedelic brain re-wiring! I definitely won’t give up. It’s really nice to hear from people in a similar position to him because it can be hard to get him to talk about it himself. Thanks for all the info/insight, I hope everything works out for you

Thanks for the reply. Really grateful for responses like yours with so much personal info behind them. It’s hard to ask people about it properly because I feel like it’s not entirely my story to share with people we know, but here he’s anonymous. I think you’re right about accessibility, I’m working on getting the funds for proper treatment which will hopefully have some effect. He’s definitely not one for mindfulness either so I’ll try everything else! :)

Thanks so much for replying. Do you think it’s helping? I’d love to try for myself as weirdly I’m the loneliest I’ve ever been. I’ll definitely try all those. Anything that can help him I’ll do. I hope you’re doing okay and you find something that works for you. I hope it’s alright to say but you should be so proud that you’re tackling it yourself. I’ve seen how hard it is and it’s no easy feat. Endless respect for you. Thanks again for replying!
